name: xTool MetalFab CNC Cutter
notes: Metal laser cutter and welder. The extension knows a 1200 W and an 800 W version.
source: Image modes: xTool Studio's image mode list, values read from projects saved by xTool Studio for the M2 (2026-11-27); assumed the same for this machine. xTool Studio 1.9.11 device extension HJ003 (exts/HJ003), read 2026-11-26. Work area from processingArea (610 x 610); power from defaultPower 1200 and the 1200 / 800 W status images. Unverified: that the source is a fiber laser (not stated in the extension), and the operations (cut and score; it also does laser cleaning, which Scriber has no operation for).
